description: The natural initial segments form a countably infinite family of finite sets, every delta-system subfamily of which has at most two members.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.natural_initial_segments_specification :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.naturalInitialSegments.Countable ∧
    Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.naturalInitialSegments.Infinite ∧
      (∀ a ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.naturalInitialSegments, a.Finite) ∧
        ∀ B ⊆ Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.naturalInitialSegments,
          ∀ (r : Set ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DeltaSystems.IsDeltaSystem B r → B.Finite ∧ B.ncard ≤ 2
